exposure: age at surgery less than 10 hours
age when feeding started less than 10 days
outcome: successful early enteral feeding (achieving full feeding within 21 days of life)
cohort: The study included 105 gastroschisis patients born between January 2006 and December 2015.
finding: Factors such as female sex, gestational age > 36 weeks, surgery within 10 hours, postoperative extubation within 4 days, and feeding started before 10 days of life were significantly associated with successful early enteral feeding in gastroschisis patients.
